text: Immediately saving $300 a month. After loading all my accounts, I found items I was paying for and didn’t want.

Probably just me, but…. Constant account connection issues, auto-generated categories as billers instead of type or wildly inaccurate categories, won’t auto recognize billers or regular bills, not all billers available to connect, etc. I’ve had this app a year and it’s at times regenerated or duplicated things or with some bills/spending marked as earning (yielding inaccurate account totals resulting in overspend). 

Again, maybe it’s me, but I didn’t have such issues with quickbooks. 🤷‍♂️

WHEN ARE YOU GOING TO FIX THIS APP?. I’ve used Quicken for over two years since switching from Mint, and until recently, I thought it was a great app. But lately, it’s become practically unusable. Everything takes forever to load, if it loads at all.

I don’t know if this started with the iOS 27 update, but clearly something is broken. Other users have been reporting the same issues, and despite multiple app updates, performance hasn’t improved.

What’s going on, Quicken? When are you going to devote the resources to fixing this? This used to be a great app. It’s frustrating to watch it deteriorate without any meaningful fix.

Not worth the money. Constantly having to edit transactions and make rules.  Never know what to do with my paycheck since I never make the same amount.  I I have to create a rule for so many transactions just as well make a spreadsheet for free and not waste $80 a year
Not what I thought it was. This definitely was a disappointment. I am going to be canceling. It is not what I thought it was.
Easy to use. I used to use the full Quicken program for work, now that I am retired I use Simplify to stay organized and on budget.

Overall satisfied, but the attachment management needs work. On the web interface, you can add PDFs. This makes it easy to scan a receipt or invoice and upload it to a transaction. On the iPhone app, you can only upload or view picture formats. 

This makes this feature next to useless on the phone unless you’re okay with a shotty phone of your receipts. I don’t understand why you can’t even view PDFs that you uploaded via the website. 

I hope they remedy this.
Best finance app. This app is the best for having an all in one look at your finances

Do not get this subscription. I had connection issues within minutes of purchasing this, and the helpdesk told me that they have connectivity issues and to bookmark alerts for when they resolve… they went on to tell me that I just had to wait it out… I just purchased the app 😂 don’t make the mistake I did and go with another budgeting app.

Worth it. Great app.. Longtime mint user and I was very sad when it died. This app is actually better than Mint. 

I tried using the lousy Credit Karma app they pushed as a replacement but it just wasn’t enough. Decided I needed to pay for a worthwhile app. I not only wanted features, I also wanted a reputable company I felt ok linking my accounts with. This app does it all and does it well.

Worth It. I have tried several free apps YNAB, Rocket Money, etc. and none of them had the functionality I needed to u destined my financial picture. I don’t really have anything complex going on just a few basic accounts. Before downloading another app I decided to look into which apps would also be protecting my info or sharing/selling it. Basically I figured out in this case, if the service/product is free YOU are the product—meaning all the data that is scraped from our use of free apps, etc. 

Quicken has a good reputation for more complex things. I’m glad I found something by them to help me simply my financial picture and patterns. I discovered I was spending ALOT more than I thought for eating out. Thanks to that info I could be aware and intentional about spending money and when to say no to meet other goals.
No calendar. I was disappointed to discover the software does not have a calendar to give you an easy bird’s eye view of when recurring expenses occur.

iOS 27 has broken Quicken app. This is a new problem. The app often fails to load, won’t refresh, and sometimes returns nothing and says I need to link accounts. This is a new set of issues that needs urgent attention for a product at this price point.

Bad new features. I have used this app for years! However, their newer features have me questioning if I should look into a different budgeting tool. You can tell the newest features were engineered using AI. None of them seem to have been properly vetted or tested by users.
Too complicated. I just wanted a simple household budget. This is full of charts and graphs and unsure results

Somewhat difficult to navigate. Some of my transactions from my checking account don’t transfer correctly to Quicken.  I have been trying for a month to track cash and ATM transactions and other watchlists that don’t work right

Complete mess. The app is a worthless mess and a waste of money.  I had a subscription in 2023 and renewed in 2026.  Even after three months of updating, the 2023 transactions come up, listed before more current 2026 transactions.  As a result, the app provides a mix of three year ago outdated information and current transactions.

Great app until it doesn’t work. I’m hopeful that this is a temporary review, but there is currently no way to get asynchronous support. 

I simply want to have a ticket opened for my issue. I do not need a chat during office hours to do this, and a Chatbot is not enough to help me.

The issue I would like addressed is how RBC wealth management investments are not syncing.  Ironically the chat, but was very helpful with creating this message with subject. Too bad I don’t have a place to send it.

Subject: RBC Wealth Management account not syncing
Message:
Hi, my RBC Wealth Management account in Simplifi is not syncing.
I've already tried reconnecting it multiple times, but it still isn't updating.
Please investigate the connection.
Details:
• Institution: RBC Wealth Management
• Issue: account not syncing
• What's missing: balances / holdings / transactions

This has been a great helper. I’ve always tracked bills in a paper bill pay book but as we are entering retirement we want to ensure we’ll be ok so I switched to Quicken Simplifi. At first I was intimidated, but then I asked ChatGPT to help me set it up and that has been very helpful to me. If you don’t understand bookkeeping enough to get this set up the way you want it to work for you I highly recommend asking for help like I did. It’s definitely a process that I did not get set up in a day or two. I’m very happy with this app. Once it’s set up it’s very easy to use.

Text no longer readable for me. Text is too small and gray.. Unfortunately I can't use the mobile app any longer. I don't see well and I cannot zoom the text. I can only use the web app now.
Having just a little large and or darker text would be helpful.
What a mess!. This app is a mess. Takes a ton of time to set up with banks, payment. And then it’s worthless.
Honest. Bottom line… amazing app

Seriously bug ridden forcing me to rethink switching from Classic desktop. Simplifi is SERIOUSLY bug ridden with bugs passed off as features. It is very common for recurring series and bank synchronization to add erroneous transactions, delete correct transactions, AND remove future transactions all in one step, forcing me to clean up the transaction mess, then figure out what future transactions may or may not have been deleted. And THIS is just ONE of number of serious bugs I have had to contact support to fix.
Each attempt to fix results to HOURS of my time wasted proving the problem exists, then WEEKS waiting for bug fixes.

Poor functionality. I have to constantly enter data manually because the app pits items in the wrong category or duplicates entries already entered. Also problems logging in and it says to contact support, but they are closed and there’s no way to send a message or put in a ticket to get help when they are back. Really clunky, buggy, and not user friendly app.

Mediocre. I started using this app after mint is no longer available. The overall experience is not super great.  The sync is never timely. Category is always off for 20% of the transactions even after repeated corrections.  Every time I opened it, I’m not sure my checking account balance is up to date. Now I just use it as a general expense tracker and will have to find a replacement. And it’s not even cheap.
Buggy. There are pretty frequent connection issues and the Transactions list has 6-7 blank lines after the first page.

Finally found a platform that works. I’ve used Mint, Chase, Fidelity, Every Dollar, and a few others I can’t remember, and Simplifi by far is the easiest to use and has the most intuitive UI. Very easy and very customizable information. You can make it as in depth or general as you want which is awesome as so many others are limited on what you can do with the options. The price for the year was a no brainer in exchange for the ease of use.

Peace of Mind. I'm recently widowed and the organization of my finances has improved because I tried this app.  It's taken almost a year to be ready for this app to come into my life. Thankfully it fits my personality.  It has helped me to forecast ahead where my money is coming in from and going out.
That's why I recommend it. 
I'm grateful for its many features and I'm only about 10 days in!!! 
Thank you. 🙌🏼
Nothing great. The system is fine and works most of the time. I continue to have ongoing problems, staying connected to Bank of America and Merrill Lynch.
Main bank disconnects regularly. I’ve been waiting for a fix on my main bank for almost a month. Every time I contact they just say there’s no updates. Going to use something else.

Mobile app doesn’t work-limited. You can’t create rules to automatically categorize transactions without further review on the mobile app. It has to be done on a web browser. If you try to access via a browser on the phone, it automatically opens the app. Don’t buy this unless you want to have to run to your computer multiple times a month to create a rule for a new transaction. 
Why don’t they just tell you this so that you don’t buy it and invest your time unnecessarily?

Incredibly glitchy. Both the mobile app and the desktop app are incredibly glitchy. Duplicate transaction glitches, glitches when canceling subscriptions, recurring transaction series glitches, graphics glitches and syncing glitches (both between mobile-desktop and with banks). It is consistently a chore to use this app. Your money would be much better spent on a different service. I will be switching this coming month.
Account Syncing. Lately some of my accounts won’t sync. Tried to login to my bank but it just spins forever and then times out.

Great replacement to Mint. I was an avid longtime user of the Mint app.  When it was discontinued, the next couple of years I went through multiple apps and software trying to replace it.  Ultimately, I used AI and asked what would be a good alternative to Mint and came to Quicken Simplifi.  I finally found exactly what I was looking for and couldn’t be happier. This is even better than Mint and I look forward to using this app for years to come.

Mobile App performance needs improved. I am a multi-year user of Quicken Simplifi since Mint shut down, and while it took time to get it up and running I am very happy with the service on desktop.

The mobile experience was fine but recently has turned abysmally slow. They need to fix this ASAP. Currently it’s broken. I tried logging out to reset the local cache and it’s been spinning for 25 minutes on the login page. Before, each transaction took 15-20 seconds to update any changes.

Mostly great. I use this primarily as a budgeting app.  I appreciate the easy downloads and the categories for planned spending.  My only gripe is that I can't see a total of the planned spending so far.   I like to look at my budget progress both globally (as in my total spent so far) and according to category.  It seems this would be an easy add.   Otherwise I think the software works great!  
One other gripe - quicken simplify should be included with a desktop quicken membership! Why do I have to pay more??!
Need some changes. Please get rid of so. I’m considering deleting because of it. Love it because it’s a mint alternative but refuse to pay anymore because of the si feature. Horrible idea!

Too much clicking. Every single time I create a rule I have to click do not ask me again. So if I create 30 rules, I’ve gotta click don’t ask me again 30 times seems pointless.

Also, when I’m trying to go through all the uncategorized expenses it switches me to another list after our updated transaction so then I have to go back to select the list uncategorized again and start the process over. 

Both of these issues need to be fixed.

I want my money back. Honestly the app sucks it needs to re authorize all my banks every 24 hrs and it practically useless. I wanted an automated expense tracking with all the ai it shouldn’t be hard but this app has made budgeting more difficult
Simple 1 min tasks turn into hr long trouble shooting

Worth every penny. Best way to see exactly where your money is going.  Very intuitive and easy to set up categories.  The alerts and reports are extremely helpful.  Tracking subscriptions is super simple and you can see bills that you have upcoming.  Highly recommend!!

QUALITY. Skeptical to trialing a new financial/budget app, but I could not recommend this product more! Simple yet customizable layout, functional interface, and very comprehensive. Seriously, if thinking about, send it! It's free and has no apps! love it
Latest update. I love this app, but whatever update was made recently has affected the quality of the display. Both my iPhone and iPad have been affected. Hopefully a fix is coming soon?

Helped me get serious about my finances. My dad recommended I start using Quicken because he’s been using it to track his and the family’s finances for decades now.
I don’t have a history of being good with money, and I’m not very knowledgeable about finances. 
I do a lot of freelance work so I bought the business version, and have been using it for almost a month.
This app has made budgeting, planning, and monitoring my accounts TREMENDOUSLY easier. It’s very easy to use, everything feels intuitive, you can get as in-depth with organizing your transactions and bills as you want. It also connects with third party apps easily. Can’t say I’ve run into any issues yet with that. I love it, and because of it, I’ve started checking my Quicken and all my accounts everyday, and I finally feel like I’m becoming responsible with my money. 
Highly recommend you get it to just make your life easier.
Too much work. Application is limited and requires a ton of work to set up and then to sift through entries from several inputs and categorize them all.
Old data. Takes days for financial information to be updated. Every time it notifies me I am already well aware of the transaction from days to weeks ago.
First time user. 1
Great program. Love this program.  Tons of info and ease of tracking everything.

Where is support?. I’ve been trying to link my bank account for a couple weeks now, and I keep getting the same error message FDP-102. I’ve changed my bank password to get rid of the “special character” I uninstalled the app and just reinstalled today and I get the same message. I give up

Should be great but…. It candidly seems like they just don’t try hard.  Example: the review transactions feature they just released.  I hit mark as reviewed.  Then wait. I mean really?  If it takes me 10 seconds to go through each transaction I’m not going to do that.  Even if the feature itself is a great idea.
Useless. A waste of time and money.
Waste of $. I had Mint, which was awesome. Quicken bought them and did not learn from them. The app is not intuitive. You need a degree to figure out how to get everything to work.

Disappointing!. If I wasn’t already invested I’d switch to something else. And after my subscription is over I plan to look elsewhere. The monthly budgeting makes no sense and is impossible to set up. In the end this app is overall fairly dissatisfying. There was a glitch after months of using the app that my credit card stopped importing into the app. They were not able to solve it with their quick fixes so they put a ticket in for someone to work on the issue….three months later I got an email with a window of time I needed to be available and if I missed it then that was it. Absolutely terrible customer support!!!

Logs me out randomly. When it works, it’s a great app. But, twice in two weeks I’ve been logged out of my Quicken account and Simplifi for no reason. The first time, I had to spend over 90 minutes on phone support to regain access. They said sometimes the app doesn’t like VPN, firewall, etc and to turn them off. If this app can’t figure out how to work with normal online safety procedure, I don’t know what to say. Today, I’ve been randomly logged out again and Quicken won’t take my password. I refuse to spend more time with support. Luckily, I’ve just found another equally useful app that begins with M. Successfully added my accounts and then canceled my Quicken subscription.

As well, there is not sufficient foreign currency support. This is an essential feature for me.

Great. Honestly the best money management app for the price. The price is fair and it does everything I need it to do to keep track of the inflow and outflow of money. Great for first timer, like myself. It is keeping me accountable.

Bank of America Sync. After Mint was acquired and gutted, I’ve been using this app to track my budget and finances. I have so much set up here, but it hasn’t been able to sync with Bank of America for over two months now, leaving a hole in my budget reporting and visibility. I’ve spoken with customer support a few times now and there’s no expectation of when the known issue will be resolved. I don’t want to start over with a different budget app, but I’m mad I’ve paid the expensive fee for this one and it’s not working as it should.

Everything in one place. Simplifi is new to me. I was using Goodbudget, but it was taking too much time from my life. This app seems to be less of a budget (still does budgeting) and more of a whole financial picture app. I love that I can see my investments and every one of our checking and savings accounts in one place. The app is intuitive and you can teach it what to do with recurring income. This saves me loads of time.

Amazing tool. This is hands down the best tool for personal tracking. I have multiple accounts and cards. Very hard to manage and was trying to do this with Quickbooks. This is 10x more user friendly. I wish used 5 years ago. I would have saved much more money!

So so. Slick and modern UI, and very responsive.
My biggest gripe with this solution is that it’s not “intuitively” accurate; the spending plan is “hit or miss” and requires too much effort yo make sure it’s setup properly and even then, it may not be. Needs work, but strong contender in the PFMS space
AI. Stop using AI.

Getting organized. It’s ok. I still find the need to use a spreadsheet.  I’d like to personalize it and can’t. It’s very limited to what it will do for me and how to function. Probably won’t stay with it

Extremely difficult to get a refund (if at all.). This application does not offer a free trial, but Quicken claims that they offer a 30-Day Money Back Guarantee. I thought “what the heck, I could try it and if it doesn’t work for me, then I can get a refund.” I was initially excited to use the application but was kinda met with a a budgeting  system that doesn’t work for me. 

I wouldn’t have minded trying to learn how to use the app, but there were some annoyances with using it. One is that the application doesn’t seem to make it easy to review and categorize any banking transactions. My biggest gripe with the app is that while they do connect with plaid, every time that I would go back to the main screen, I would be asked to reauthenticate my bank with simplifi. I’m all for security but other applications make this entirely seamless.

I’ve decided that this application wasn’t worth it for me and I have requested a refund. Apparently “30-Day Money-Back Guarantee” has absolutely no meaning if you subscribe to their app via the App Store. Mind you, I’m asking for a refund only 6 days after purchasing and using the app. I filed a request for refund through Apple twice, and they denied me a refund both times, claiming that I and not eligible for a refund and this decision is final. I went to quicken and they claimed that they do not process refunds and that would be handled via Apple. 

I’ve spend 3 hours going back and forth between both companies, and have not been granted a resolution. I have requested from quicken a manual override, since they received my hard-earned money. I escalated this to their customer support supervisor and was told something to the effect of “tough, contact Apple for those disputes.” 

I firmly let them know that since they are the 3rd party developer that handles and processes these overrides that they are essentially in violation of deceptive advertising practices. Like Dude… your website says “Money-Back-Guarantee.” I’ve had no choice but to escalate this to the FTC and have filed a complaint with the better business bureau. 

Never in my life have I thought that I would have to file a legal complaint against it, but if they seriously want to waste more money fighting legal challenges, doesn’t that tell you a lot about their business practices?
Simplifi. Easy to set up. For me it’s great! Tracking my finances - I only have to look in one place for everything. Love it!

Horrible Support. They force you to use a bot for support, which is not helpful most of the time. And then you finally get an agent, who is only helpful some time, but mostly just telling you to delete and reinstall the app or use the web version as an alternative.
Waste of money. Tried it for a year. Takes way too much time to set up, constantly having to re-log into accounts. And it doesn’t do anything that a spreadsheet doesn’t do
Don’t do it. It used to work fine, now accounts won’t connect. Don’t waste your money (irony is heavy here)
Another subscription…. App is now deleted. Yet another app requiring a subscription cost to be able to use it. My goodness, EVERYTHING is a subscription these days!

Typical Intuit Product. Simplifi suffers from the same poor development as the larger products I use like QBO. Poor syncing capabilities with external accounts (the number one reason I wanted to try Simplifi), and an interface that is very counter-intuitive at times. Support is also garbage, unless you like "disconnect the account, and wait 24hrs" as an answer to your issues. Their "solutions" don't work.
It ok. The app will allow you to view your info but that is pretty much all I can count on.  I can generally make one update to a transaction but subsequent updates fail.

Good for tracking spend, difficult for following a budget. I’ve been using Simplifi (maybe renamed now?) for a while and the tracking of spend and investments has been working well for me. However, trying to use the app to track spend against a budget has been problematic. It’s like the focus is on cash flow rather than spend. So if there is no income (i.e. retirement) then trying to use the “Spending Plan” feature as an “envelope” system doesn’t really work. Nor do watch lists as they are fixed to the current calendar year (as far as I can tell). I’d love better features for tracking spend against a budget for use in no-income (aka retirement) circumstances.

Absolutely Useless; Totally SUCKS!. Continually provides inaccurate information.  So many useless notifications is a huge distraction.  Shows one-time payments from years past as monthly recurring charges.  This subscription was a big waste of money.
Useless. Don’t bother. Does not work.

Wasting Time. By all means download this app if you enjoy sync errors, debits marked as credits, incompatible accounts, and missing transactions.  I spend more time making corrections than I do analyzing my finances.

Used to be good, WOULD NOT RECOMMEND NOW. I’ve been a Simplifi user for years now, ever since they shut down mint. The app had been working okay for the most part, however, in the last few months it’s gotten worse and worse. Nothing is categorized correctly, even after I manually update the category multiple times. The rules are completely broken, and nothing gets split or categorized correctly. Honestly, this app is a hollow crappier version of its former self. I’m actively migrating to something else, and I advise everyone else to do the same. This had the potential to be good, but given the numerous price hikes, I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone. Garbage.
Needs usability testing.. This could be a really great app but falls apart on usability for most of the little things.

New user to Q. I always thought I had decent financial literacy. After putting in all my financial information and letting Q crunch it all together, I realized how much I didn’t know! My financial literacy has shot up with the powerful tool of Q. If you’re serious about managing your finances, use Q. The cost of this product has already paid for itself many times over for me.

Great Web based Financial Product. I love the comprehensive subjects that are recorded, downloaded and/or reported on. It truly is a time saver and reference point to analyze & document personal, Contractual and Self-Employed finances.

If I may add a "wish feature" or 2, it would be:
1. Add Horizontal scroll bars along with the current Vertical scroll bars.
2. Add an "instant back" link to my previous page. Currently, I must use menus to navigate back to my previous page.

Poor replacement for Mint. When Mint shut down I was forced to look elsewhere for a budget tracking app. Quicken Simplifi is begrudgingly what I opted to use based on other reviews and it has been an incredibly frustrating experience. I am constantly having to correct how it categorizes purchases, it doesn’t seem to automatically categorize at all based on words in the purchase or even based on the merchants that I’ve made purchases with previously. Frequently I’m having to direct recurring bills or payments to the ones I’ve asked it to track. The process of having to set up my accounts and budgets all over again in another app is the only thing keeping me on this one. Please, developers, DO BETTER TO IMPROVE YOUR PRODUCT.

Not good. Was working alright but randomly would stop working and i would need to reset all my recurring bills etc. then suddenly stopped connecting to my bank account and wouldnt reconnect so im left with the wrong info and no way to fix it.
Issues linking accounts. I’ve had issues linking accounts I wish there had been a trial so I didn’t waste money.

Needs major improvement. The auto sort into categories is poor. There is not default category for subscriptions.  I spend most of my time in the app correcting the transaction category.  Mint was the gold standard and that was years ago. Now you have to pay for products that don’t come anywhere near the simplicity and ease of use Mint had for free for over a decade

Biggest pain to cancel. Do not get if you’re not sure, to delete your data you have to fill forms, call customer support, and jump through sooo many hoops just to delete your account. DO NOT recommend at all.

Not bad - meets my need. I’m a long time Quicken user, since it was on a 5.25 floppy disk (LOL). I stopped using it about 15 years ago due to lack of parity on Mac with Windows version. About 5 years ago, I started using it again but was disillusioned by how clumsy it was on Mac and how often it lost my data whenever an update arrived. I started to revert to my old way of tracking on spreadsheets and was fumbling along looking at alternatives when an offer to use Simplifi came up. I thought I’d give it a fair shot and did - after about 2 weeks of using it, it meets my needs. It’s not fantastic but I have one tool to look at all my accounts at the same time. Thats actually quite helpful.

Decent until recently. Very long time Quicken user. Simplifi was decent until recently. I lost my connection to Venmo last year and have never been able to reconnect. Not a huge deal, just been entering the transactions manually. Now, after recent update, i can no longer connect to Robinhood. It’s been 9 days, and is a much bigger deal since i do most banking through Robinhood. I have seen multiple people posting online having same issue. Wish Quicken would take a more serious response to the issue, like sending an email addressing the problem. Quicken assist, the automated assistant is no help. Disabled accounts and tried numerous times to reconnect, but keep getting the same error… FDP -101.

Accounts Lose Connectivity by the Day. Quicken Simplifi has been a huge disappointment. I have multiple high-usage accounts that have lost connectivity, and there does not appear to be any real resolution in sight. On top of that, manual accounts are calculated incorrectly, which makes the app unreliable for tracking my finances. For something that requires an annual subscription, the service is abysmal and nowhere close to acceptable. I expected a paid product to be stable and responsive, but this has been frustrating and unusable.

Not consistent or easy. Don’t believe the other reviews. This program is glitchy at best and problematic at worst.  Doesn’t maintain connections to accounts - constantly having to reconnect. Way too expensive for the countless issues and lack of truly valuable information. Does not recognize payments made and shows late payments.  Terrible. Really.

DO NOT BUY. After uploading five months of transactions into Quicken Simplifi, Budget, I discovered that there are no memo fields to identify transactions within the software. For instance, PayPal transactions come through as PayPal transaction. But gives you no hint in Simplifi what the transaction was for. And there is no editable field to indicate the vendor. Also, the reports are very limited in Simplifi, and you cannot print out category lists or account lists. I also just found out that there is no way to transfer transactions from simplify into quicken classic deluxe so I will have to start from scratch in order to get memo fields. I am not happy!
Latest update. After the latest update I can no longer access my Robinhood details in app

Rule creation BAD. They removed the option to add a rule when renaming/recatogorizing a transaction. They make a lot of mistakes with categories and now it’s a FULLY manual Process to have future transaction categorized properly.

STAY AWAY!. They will set you up for a $90 automatic renewal and will keep it even if you cancel the day it renews.  They make it extremely difficult to cancel.  The App is useless.  They don’t offer anything you can’t do on your own. Alerts are always a week late and seldom correct. Avoid at all cost.
Confusing. I hate it
SCAM!!Can’t refund!!. I’m trying to get a refund but the phone number isn’t even a real business number and they don’t answer!!!

Can no longer sync my primary account. The app is decent. It would be great if transaction categories could be saved. If I apply a category to a transaction, it should carry over, by default, to all future transactions from the same business. Also, my primary bank hasn’t been supported by Quicken for at least six months now. It was working when I first started using Quicken. A message pops up saying Quicken is aware of the issue and working with the bank. The data in Quicken is not useful to me if it doesn’t include the account I use the most. If it can’t be re-added to Quicken, I’ll have to find another product.
Do not waste your money!. No customer service or help when app is not working correctly
Easy but missing key items. The app is easy to use but is a letdown with budgeting and reporting

Have to Provide Phone Number. You can’t create an account without providing your phone number. I get enough spam calls as it is. I don’t need to give my phone number just to see if the app is even useful

Recent updates have made this app so bad. I’m getting tired of these vibe code changes recently. They’ve changed reports so much that they’re unusable right now. They show you a bunch of unusable tiles on the report screen so you can’t even see all the categories right now, just the“top” ones. Good thing my subscription is ending soon not coming back to this app.

Ok. Not great. Probably bad.. Frequently misclassifies transactions, often renames payees inaccurately, and struggles with tracking recurring transactions (both missing transactions and linking transactions to a series that are completely unrelated. Spending Plan feature is useless. The reports are ok and being able to visualize aggregated income/expenses and spending categories across multiple accounts is essential.

Compatibility. With Apple, Apple Watch.. One of the most complete finance management applications, but it needs compatibility with Apple Watch for better comfort, when it comes to seeing finances from the comfort of your hand

Super helpful. The annual subscription is absolutely worth it. I can see all of mine and my fiancé’s assets at once, categorize transactions at any time, and edit what’s needed to make the monthly reports useful for my budgeting. My only issue is that a lot of the recurring bills settings and categorizing have to be done manually, the software isn’t perfect at doing it automatically. If you don’t adjust it yourself then the report and alerts it provides you won’t be accurate.

Too buggy for a paid app, hard to believe there is anything worse out there.. Great if you don’t mind reclassifying transactions every couple months. Not sure how it has 4 stars. I have used it for more than 2 years (since intuit killed mint). I am ready to try something new.

Cash transactions. The app is very helpful overall, but one major limitation affects real-world use: cash transactions cannot be closed automatically within a series unless they’re linked to a digital payment.

In many everyday situations, cash is still the only acceptable form of payment. For example, I hire a lawn-mowing service in the summer and a snow-shoveling service in the winter. Both providers only accept cash, which is very common for seasonal or independent workers. Because the app forces every transaction to be tied to a digital payment, there’s currently no way to close these entries properly unless I link them to something that doesn’t exist.

Not all transactions in the world will be cashless, and the system shouldn’t assume they are. It would be extremely helpful if the app could allow cash-based entries to be created, recorded, and closed automatically as part of a series without requiring a linked digital payment.

This change would better reflect real-life financial scenarios and make the app much more flexible for users who work with both digital and cash payments.
